# key scheme

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:keyScheme`](gmeow-keyScheme.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/keyScheme>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/trust`](../../slices/trust.md)

The scheme/format of a cryptographic key (one of the [`gmeow:KeyScheme`](../classes/gmeow-KeyScheme.md) individuals). Functional: a key has exactly one scheme — a key of a different scheme is a different key.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:CryptographicKey`](../classes/gmeow-CryptographicKey.md) -> [`gmeow:KeyScheme`](../classes/gmeow-KeyScheme.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:keyScheme`](gmeow-keyScheme.md) from [`gmeow:CryptographicKey`](../classes/gmeow-CryptographicKey.md) to [`gmeow:KeyScheme`](../classes/gmeow-KeyScheme.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
